headline: General Dynamics (GD) Lands $1.3 Billion Cybersecurity Contract With A Key Defense Customer
summary: General Dynamics (NYSE:GD) unit GDIT has been awarded a US$1.3b multi year contract to provide network operations and cybersecurity support for the Army National Guard. The award expands GDIT's role in defense IT and cybersecurity services for a key federal customer. The contract highlights growing demand for advanced technologies and AI capabilities in US national defense infrastructure. headline: Does Record Backlog And Raised 2026 Outlook Change The Bull Case For General Dynamics (GD)?
summary: General Dynamics recently reported past second-quarter 2026 results showing revenue of US$14.09 billion and net income of US$1.16 billion, while its board elected long-time executive and current president Danny Deep to the board of directors and affirmed a regular quarterly dividend of US$1.59 per share. These results were accompanied by a record backlog of US$136.50 billion and higher full-year 2026 guidance, underscoring strong demand across all four business segments. With this backdrop...
